title: Track A — CAD-inference request (POST /v1/predictions/cad-tabular)
description: Request body for the cross-sectional CAD-classification inference endpoint. The feature payload is dataset-specific and is bound to a versioned feature schema; in M1a.1 the only available feature schemas are MOCK_ONLY placeholders, because the clinical dictionaries have not passed Gate DA (Phase 0 §F-3, D-031).
x-validation-layers: Layer 1 (this file): structural JSON Schema validation of the envelope.

Layer 2 (semantic, implemented by the reference validator in tests/contracts): version compatibility, source admissibility, wearable rejection, model/schema binding, per-feature unit and range rules, required-feature rules. Layer 2 runs first so that a violation is reported with the specific contract error code instead of a generic schema violation.

request_id.description: Client-generated correlation id. Informational only: idempotency is governed by the Idempotency-Key header, and request_id is excluded from the canonical payload hash (Phase 0 §R2-6.1).

model_id.description: Optional explicit model selection. When omitted, the active model of the deployment is used. A model is bound to exactly one feature schema; a mismatch fails with 422 schema_model_mismatch (Phase 0 §R2-6.2).

feature_schema_id.description: Identifier of the versioned feature schema the payload is expressed in. An unknown identifier fails with 422 unknown_feature_schema.

features.description: Feature map. The concrete per-feature rules (unit, value range, required/optional) live in the referenced feature schema, selected by feature_schema_id.

consent_id.description: Consent reference when the request is linked to a consented record. Prototype-grade reference only; no identifiers, no PHI.
